inputs.text: Panoramic album cover artwork, one continuous landscape composition. A kinetic light sculpture in a dark performance space, captured as a long-exposure art photograph. At the RIGHT side, a thick luminous bundle of closely spaced fine cyan, ivory, and hot vermilion light traces is folded into an extraordinary three-dimensional sweeping fan; the strands turn sharply together, open into a delicate broadly spaced fan, then cross again in a bright knot. Each individual strand has a hairline-sharp trailing edge and a brighter point, as if multiple signals were brought into phase by a single gesture. Spare matte midnight-blue ground, etched line quality, beautifully intentional rhythmic gaps, graphic Japanese electronic record art, elegant and boldly asymmetric. LEFT third is deep clean shadow for typography; most of the curves occupy the centre and right. Not a landscape scene. No holographic interfaces, no generic circuit boards, no gradient blobs, no words, no symbols, no logos, no humans, no lettering.
